notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments; additional ones beyond this minimum can reduce the mana needed.
description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Dockside Extortionist and creating two 1/1 token copies of it.
When the Dockside Extortionist tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating at least eight Treasure tokens in total.
Cast Mechanized Production by paying {2}{U}{U} while keeping at least seven Treasures on the battlefield, attaching it to a Treasure you control.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, causing you to create a token of the artifact Mechanized Production is attached to and win the game.
